note: Small SRA just off I-80 W of Kearney near Elm Creek, with a 12-acre no-wake lake (electric-motor and non-powered boats, gravel ramp, no dock). Non-pad sites on a gravel loop among shade trees on the north shore, with picnic tables and fire rings. --Claude

Confirmed 5 non-pad sites, no electric, FCFS iron ranger; modern restrooms written as flush_toilets. potable_water and vault_toilets stay as derived (page silent). Fees left.
